title: The View on China's ¥20 Bill Is Real — Li River | China Travel Expert
description:
The landscape printed on China's ¥20 banknote is a real place you can cruise: the Li River near Xingping.

The note's view is the "Reflection of Yellow Cloth Shoal," a stretch of karst peaks close to Xingping Old Town and Nine-Horse Fresco Hill. The classic day cruise runs about 60 km downstream from Guilin to Yangshuo (roughly 4–5 hours) past bamboo groves, water buffalo, and cormorant fishermen who still work the river — mostly for photos now, but the birds are real.

🧭 Expert Tip: Pull out a ¥20 note near Xingping and line it up with the peaks — the match is exact. Sit on the boat's right side heading downstream for the best angle.

二十元人民币背面的山水，就在漓江兴坪——上船坐右边，风景对得上纸币。
